title: Towards a Deductive Verification Infrastructure for Weighted Programming
authors: Emma Ahrens, Samuel Rode, Philipp Schröer, Joost-Pieter Katoen
publish: arXiv
abstract: Weighted programs extend guarded commands with trace weights drawn from a semiring, or more generally a monoid-module. Varying this algebra gives one programmatic syntax for a variety of quantitative and symbolic models. Weakest-preweighting semantics provides a compositional basis for reasoning about those programs. We present a deductive verification framework based on a weighted assertion language and an intermediate verification language. Its weight domains are ordered structures with implication and coimplication, which let verification conditions express lower- and upper-bound obligations internally. We prove sound translations of core commands and reusable encodings for various proof rules applying to procedure calls and loops. To facilitate automation, we prove soundness of a quantifier elimination procedure for our assertion language. A prototype in the Caesar verifier checks case studies for probabilistic queueing costs, recursive database provenance with cyclic dependencies, clearance bounds for networks of arbitrary size, and formal-language reasoning about lock-freedom of a compare-and-swap counter.
title_zh: 面向加权编程的演绎验证基础设施
abstract_zh: 加权程序扩展了卫式命令，其迹权重取自一个半环，或更一般地，取自一个幺半群模。改变这一代数，就可以用一种程序化语法来表达多种定量和符号模型。最弱预权重语义为对这些程序进行推理提供了组合式基础。我们提出了一种基于加权断言语言和中间验证语言的演绎验证框架。其权重域是带有蕴含和余蕴含的有序结构，这使得验证条件能够在内部表达下界和上界的证明义务。我们证明了核心命令的翻译是可靠的，也证明了适用于过程调用和循环的各种证明规则的可重用编码是可靠的。为了促进自动化，我们还证明了针对我们的断言语言的一个量词消去过程的可靠性。Caesar 验证器中的一个原型对以下案例研究进行了验证：概率排队成本、具有循环依赖的递归数据库溯源、任意规模网络的安全许可界限，以及关于比较并交换计数器无锁性的形式语言推理。

title: Code Health in LLM-Based Test Generation: Effectiveness and Token Efficiency
authors: Freya Wirdemann, Markus Borg, Nadim Hagatulah, Adam Tornhill
publish: arXiv
abstract: Coding agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) are now prominent in software engineering. Previous work has shown that AI tools perform better on high-quality source code that is easy to maintain. In this study, we investigate how the effectiveness of LLM-generated unit tests varies across maintainability levels measured by CodeScene's CodeHealth (CH). We assess test effectiveness using traditional coverage metrics and mutation score across Python, Java, and C++. Moreover, we study how code with different levels of CH translates into input tokens using common industrial tokenizers. Our results suggest that CH provides a weak but consistent signal of LLM-generated test effectiveness and is negatively correlated with input-token count. These findings provide further evidence for a relationship between maintainability and LLM-based software development.
title_zh: 基于大语言模型的测试生成中的代码健康：有效性与Token效率
abstract_zh: 由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的编码智能体如今在软件工程中占据重要地位。先前的研究表明，AI工具在易于维护的高质量源代码上表现更好。在本研究中，我们考察了由LLM生成的单元测试的有效性如何随CodeScene的CodeHealth（CH）所衡量的可维护性水平而变化。我们使用传统的覆盖率指标和变异得分来评估测试有效性，涵盖Python、Java和C++。此外，我们研究了不同CH级别的代码如何通过常见的工业分词器转化为输入词元。我们的结果表明，CH为LLM生成的测试有效性提供了一个微弱但一致的信号，并且与输入词元数量呈负相关。这些发现进一步证明了可维护性与基于LLM的软件开发之间存在关联。

title: CauSec: Unboxing the Causal Drivers of Static Vulnerability Analysis Performance
authors: Md Akram Khan, Daniel Rodriguez-Cardenas, Alejandro Velasco Dimate, Denys Poshyvanyk, Adwait Nadkarni
publish: arXiv
abstract: Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tools are widely used in both industry and academia. Such tools often make design choices that sacrifice detection to achieve higher performance, i.e., increased precision, decreased runtime, or increased scalability. These design choices rely on certain assumptions regarding the target code or the analysis technique itself. Hence, the assumptions directly impact the detection outcome through the design choices they influence. This motivates a key question: do the sacrifices in the detection capabilities actually help tools achieve the expected performance gains? That is, are the underlying assumptions valid? This paper seeks to address this question by relying on a key observation that the assumptions made by these tools are generally of a causal nature. We propose CAUSEC, a causal analysis framework that makes SAST assumptions testable and explains why the performance changes given certain assumptions, beyond simple correlations. CAUSEC formalizes the assumptions of the SAST tool into the abstraction of a security assumption and combines assumption-driven causal modeling with effect estimation and validation to test its validity and investigate the factors affecting it. To understand what security assumptions generally entail, we perform a systematic literature review of SASTs that detect crypto-API misuse, leading to the discovery and qualitative analysis of 57 assumptions. We then demonstrate the utility and robustness of CAUSEC by testing a popular assumption in four highly relevant tools, using a manually labeled ground truth dataset consisting of 57,038 alerts. Our analysis leads to several key findings that represent insights regarding assumptions and causal effects, which we distill into 3 takeaways for future work.
title_zh: CauSec：解构静态漏洞分析性能的因果驱动因素
abstract_zh: 静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具在工业界和学术界均被广泛使用。此类工具在设计时往往做出某些取舍，以牺牲检测能力为代价来换取更高的性能，即更高的精确度、更短的运行时间或更强的可扩展性。这些设计选择依赖于对目标代码或分析技术本身的某些假设。因此，这些假设通过其所影响的设计选择直接作用于检测结果。这引出了一个关键问题：检测能力上的牺牲是否真的能帮助工具实现预期的性能提升？换言之，这些潜在假设是否成立？本文旨在通过一个关键观察来回答这一问题，即这些工具所做的假设通常具有因果性质。我们提出了CAUSEC，一个因果分析框架，该框架使SAST假设变得可检验，并能够解释在给定某些假设的情况下性能为何发生变化，而不仅仅是简单的相关性。CAUSEC将SAST工具的假设形式化为安全假设的抽象，并将假设驱动的因果建模与效应估计和验证相结合，以检验假设的有效性并探究影响其成立的因素。为了解安全假设通常包含哪些内容，我们对检测加密API误用的SAST工具进行了系统性文献综述，发现并定性分析了57个假设。随后，我们通过在一个由57,038条告警组成的人工标注真值数据集上，对四个高度相关工具中的一个常见假设进行检验，展示了CAUSEC的实用性和稳健性。我们的分析得出了若干关键发现，这些发现代表了关于假设和因果效应的深刻见解，我们将其提炼为对未来工作的3条启示。

title: OdinEval: A Reproducible Benchmark for LLM-Based Program Repair in the Odin Programming Language
authors: Bang Xie, Hao Liu, Zhiyuan Peng, Xin Yin, Senjian Zhang, Yuan Luo, Chenhao Ying, Haiming Jin, Wei Chen, Shaocong Long, Zhenyu Shi
publish: arXiv
abstract: Repository-level repair benchmarks still center on a few mainstream languages, leaving systems languages such as Odin largely untested. We present OdinEval, a reproducible benchmark built from documented defects in public Odin repositories. Each instance binds an issue to base and fix commits, a gold patch, an issue-specific regression test, a historical toolchain, and execution records. Admission requires the test to fail on the base revision and pass after the gold fix. When no usable developer test exists, a black-box test is reviewed independently by three instances of the same model, executed in both historical states, and revised from recorded feedback under a versioned Test Writing Skill. We evaluate six language models on 168 filtered instances under one shared protocol. Kimi-K3 records the highest Resolved score at 66.7%, while Qwen3.8-Max has the highest Repro score at 96.4%. The release includes frozen data, source archives, containers, validators, model patches, and audit manifests.
title_zh: OdinEval：Odin编程语言中基于LLM的程序修复的可复现基准
abstract_zh: 仓库级修复基准仍然集中在少数主流语言上，导致诸如 Odin 这样的系统语言在很大程度上未被测试。我们提出 OdinEval，一个可复现的基准，构建自公共 Odin 仓库中有记录的缺陷。每个实例将一个 issue 绑定到基础提交和修复提交、一个黄金补丁、一个针对该 issue 的回归测试、一个历史工具链以及执行记录。准入要求该测试在基础修订版上失败，并在黄金修复后通过。当没有可用的开发者测试时，一个黑盒测试会由同一模型的三个实例独立评审，在两个历史状态下执行，并根据版本化的测试编写技能下的记录反馈进行修订。我们在一个共享协议下评估了六个语言模型，处理 168 个过滤后的实例。Kimi-K3 记录了最高的 Resolved 分数，为 66.7%，而 Qwen3.8-Max 的 Repro 分数最高，为 96.4%。发布内容包括冻结的数据、源代码归档、容器、验证器、模型补丁和审计清单。

title: Coverage-Driven RTL Assertion Generation with Formal Exploration and Neuro-Symbolic Refinement
authors: Zhiyuan Yan, Ziyue Zheng, Hongce Zhang
publish: arXiv
abstract: Hardware functional verification relies on high-quality assertions to expose design bugs and establish confidence in Register Transfer Level (RTL) designs. Yet existing assertion mining methods still struggle to produce complete and reliable assertion sets: random or limited traces fail to cover hard-to-reach behaviors, and one-shot generation provides little feedback about what remains unverified or how the assertion set should be improved. As a result, critical design behaviors can remain uncovered even when many assertions are generated. We present NeuroAssertion, a coverage-driven assertion generation framework that combines formal trace generation, syntax-guided synthesis (SyGuS), and an agent-inspired refinement process within a unified framework. Our framework first converts hard-to-reach control-flow conditions into formal reachability objectives, uses model checking to generate behaviorally diverse traces, and mines initial assertions from these traces with SyGuS. It then performs targeted agent-inspired refinement under verification feedback: one LLM first proposes candidate assertions for uncovered regions, and if a candidate fails formal checking, a second LLM generates a repair grammar that guides constrained symbolic synthesis in a neuro-symbolic repair procedure. Experimental results show that this framework delivers around 2X more assertions and about 2X higher mutation coverage than traditional assertion mining methods.
title_zh: 覆盖率驱动的RTL断言生成：形式化探索与神经符号细化
abstract_zh: 硬件功能验证依赖于高质量断言来暴露设计缺陷，并建立对寄存器传输级（RTL）设计的信心。然而，现有的断言挖掘方法仍然难以生成完整且可靠的断言集：随机或有限的轨迹无法覆盖难以触及的行为，而一次性生成几乎不提供关于哪些尚未验证以及应如何改进断言集的反馈。因此，即使生成了大量断言，关键设计行为仍可能未被覆盖。我们提出NeuroAssertion，一种覆盖驱动的断言生成框架，将形式化轨迹生成、语法引导合成（SyGuS）和受智能体启发的改进过程统一在同一框架中。该框架首先将难以触及的控制流条件转化为形式化可达性目标，使用模型检测生成行为多样的轨迹，并利用SyGuS从这些轨迹中挖掘初始断言。随后，在验证反馈下进行有针对性的受智能体启发的改进：一个LLM首先为未覆盖区域提出候选断言；若候选断言未通过形式化检查，则第二个LLM生成修复语法，以指导约束符号合成，形成神经符号修复过程。实验结果表明，该框架相比传统断言挖掘方法，能生成约2倍的断言，突变覆盖率也约提高2倍。

title: Metrics That Write Themselves: Evolving an Evaluator from Its Own Blind Spots
authors: Xing Zhang, Yanwei Cui, Guanghui Wang, Zhihao Lin, Peiyang He
publish: arXiv
abstract: Agents improve quickly against a reliable automatic metric and stall without one, and the applications that need them most, report generation among them, are the ones nobody knows how to score. Can the metric write itself? Saying what makes an answer good is hard; pointing at something wrong with one is easier, so the metric we evolve is a pool of small Python operators that each flag a candidate for one named defect, or abstain, and vote. Asking a model for operators directly does not work: 183 candidates realise only 96 distinct behaviours, from one narrow region of an enormous space. EvalCEGAR instead borrows counterexample-guided abstraction refinement from program verification. It reads the pool as an abstraction and searches for a collision, two answers the operators score identically, one correct and one not. That pair, not a prompt, is the authoring request, and when a collision defeats every attempt the loop widens what an operator may read rather than resampling. On MBPP+ and HumanEval+, a sandbox whose hidden unit tests give exact ground truth, the loop writes a 55-line operator that closes 15.4% of the gap between flagging nothing and a perfect filter on 428 unseen tasks (+0.0065, p=0.0010) at a quarter of our best hand-written operator's flags. On the benchmark it never saw it matches that operator's effect exactly on a third of the flags. Six of eight runs admit such an operator and all six help out of sample; our 15 hand-written operators applied together as one filter lose accuracy. An LLM judge on the same information ties that delta on a nearly disjoint set of candidates, and charges a model call per candidate forever where the operator charges none.
title_zh: 自我书写的度量：从其自身盲点进化评估器
abstract_zh: 智能体能凭可靠的自动评估指标快速改进，没有指标则会停滞不前；而最需要这类指标的应用——包括报告生成——恰恰是没人知道如何评分的那一类。评估指标能自己写出自己吗？说清一个答案好在哪里很难；指出一个答案哪里不对则更容易，因此我们演化出的指标是一个小型 Python 算子池，每个算子要么针对某个指定缺陷标记候选答案，要么弃权，然后投票。直接让模型生成算子行不通：183 个候选算子只实现了 96 种不同行为，而且都来自巨大空间中的一个狭窄区域。EvalCEGAR 则借鉴了程序验证中的反例引导抽象精化。它把算子池视为一种抽象，并寻找碰撞：两个答案被算子们给出相同评分，但一个正确、一个不正确。这一对答案——而非提示词——才是创作请求；当某个碰撞挫败了所有尝试时，循环会扩大算子可读取的内容，而不是重新采样。在 MBPP+ 和 HumanEval+ 这个沙盒上（其隐藏单元测试提供精确的真实标签），该循环写出一个 55 行的算子，在 428 个未见任务上，以我们最佳手写算子四分之一的标记量，弥合了“什么都不标记”与“完美过滤器”之间差距的 15.4%（+0.0065，p=0.0010）。在它从未见过的基准上，该算子在三分之一的标记上与那个手写算子的效果完全一致。八次运行中有六次产生这样的算子，且六个都在样本外有效；而我们 15 个手写算子合并为一个过滤器时反而损失准确率。基于相同信息的 LLM 评判器在几乎互不重叠的候选集上打平了这一差值，却要对每个候选永久收取一次模型调用费用，而该算子分文不取。

title: Beyond Placement and Articulation: Usage-Driven Code Scenes for Embodied Interaction
authors: Zijian Xiao, Zipeng Ye, Jinkun Hao, Xiong Yang, Yuchen Xie, Ran Yi
publish: arXiv
abstract: Indoor scene synthesis provides essential environments for embodied AI, robotic manipulation, and simulation-based policy learning. Recent code-based scene generation methods produce editable and extensible environments, yet they remain focused on visual construction and object-level articulation, leaving the functional usage of scenes largely unmodeled. To address this problem, we present RoomWright, an agentic usage-driven framework for generating 3D scenes represented entirely as code for embodied interaction. RoomWright performs usage-driven object reasoning, which treats each anchor as a task centre and admits task-required objects and their affordances. A code agent further enables multi-part interaction by compiling each interaction into a trigger, condition, effect rule that updates structured object states, capturing causal dependencies across objects. Moreover, since manipuland orientation is ambiguous and hard to recover from pixels, RoomWright alleviates this via annotation-informed usage-guided orientation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. The resulting scenes are executable, editable, and simulation-ready, providing interactive environments for embodied AI and policy learning.
title_zh: 超越放置与表达：面向具身交互的用法驱动代码场景
abstract_zh: 室内场景合成为具身智能、机器人操作和基于仿真的策略学习提供了关键环境。近年来的基于代码的场景生成方法能够生成可编辑且可扩展的环境，但这些方法仍主要聚焦于视觉构建和物体级别的关节（articulation），场景的功能性用途在很大程度上未被建模。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RoomWright——一个智能体式（agentic）、使用驱动（usage-driven）的框架，用于生成完全以代码表示的3D场景以支持具身交互。RoomWright执行使用驱动的对象推理，将每个锚点视为任务中心，并纳入任务所需的对象及其功能可供性（affordances）。代码智能体进一步通过将每个交互编译为触发—条件—效果规则来实现多部件交互，该规则更新结构化对象状态，从而捕获对象之间的因果依赖关系。此外，由于操作物的朝向存在歧义且难以从像素中恢复，RoomWright通过基于标注信息的使用引导朝向缓解了这一问题。大量实验证明了我们方法的有效性。生成的场景可执行、可编辑且可直接用于仿真，为具身智能和策略学习提供了交互式环境。

title: AppEval: A Unified Benchmark for LLM-Based Mobile Application Repair in ArkTS, Swift, and Kotlin
authors: Bang Xie, Hao Liu, Zhenyu Shi, Yonghao Zhang, Senjian Zhang, Zhiyuan Peng, Xin Yin, Chenhao Ying, Yuan Luo, Wei Chen, Haiming Jin, Shaocong Long, Xu Liu, Zhe Peng
publish: arXiv
abstract: Repository-level LLM agents are typically evaluated on projects whose tests run on the build host. It remains unclear whether their repairs survive the mobile build-install-launch-test boundary, where a missing SDK, offline device, or pre-assertion crash can be mistaken for a program failure. We present AppEval, a benchmark and native-toolchain evaluation framework for mobile application repair across HarmonyOS/ArkTS, iOS/Swift, and Android/Kotlin. Each task separates a hidden behavior test from the reference production fix and is accepted only when the same installed-app target reaches an assertion failure on the defective revision and passes after the fix; infrastructure failures remain a distinct outcome. A common schema maps this contract to each platform's build system, runtime, and test runner. The audited Android partition contains 200 accepted instrumentation tasks from 24 independently buildable repositories. On these tasks, five agents achieve Pass@1 between 22.00% and 90.50%, a 68.50-percentage-point spread under the same dynamic oracle. These results show that mobile repair performance depends strongly on the evaluated agent while demonstrating why runtime-aware acceptance is necessary for meaningful comparison. The quantitative findings in this paper are Android-specific; audited iOS and HarmonyOS results are required before drawing cross-platform generalization conclusions.
title_zh: AppEval：面向 ArkTS、Swift 和 Kotlin 的基于大语言模型的移动应用修复统一基准
abstract_zh: 仓库级LLM智能体的评估通常在构建主机上运行测试的项目上进行。然而，它们所生成的修复能否跨越移动端“构建-安装-启动-测试”这一边界，目前仍不明确——在这一边界中，缺失的SDK、离线设备或断言前的崩溃都可能被误判为程序故障。我们提出了AppEval，一个面向鸿蒙OS/ArkTS、iOS/Swift和Android/Kotlin移动应用修复的基准测试及原生工具链评估框架。每个任务都将隐藏的行为测试与参考生产修复方案分离，并且只有当同一已安装应用目标在缺陷版本上到达断言失败、在修复后通过测试时，该任务才被接受；基础设施故障则始终被列为独立的结果类别。一个统一的模式将该契约映射到各平台的构建系统、运行时和测试运行器上。经过审计的Android部分包含来自24个可独立构建的代码仓库的200个已接受的instrumentation测试任务。在这些任务上，五个智能体在相同的动态测试基准下，Pass@1得分介于22.00%至90.50%之间，差距达68.50个百分点。这些结果表明，移动端修复性能在很大程度上取决于被评估的智能体，同时也说明了为何运行时感知的接受标准对于有意义的比较是必要的。本文中的量化研究结果仅针对Android平台；在得出跨平台泛化结论之前，需要先获得经审计的iOS和鸿蒙OS结果。

title: What is Missing from AI Post-Training AI: An Empirical Analysis
authors: Joy Jia Yin Lim, Xin Huang, Hao Peng, Yaxi Lu, Xin Cong, Zhong Zhang, Maosong Sun, Yankai Lin
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now post-train an LLM end-to-end. They can write code, launch training, evaluate checkpoints, and improve downstream performance, raising the prospect of AI-for-AI. We argue that this picture conflates two distinct capabilities: execution-level capability, iterating within a selected training strategy; and strategy-level capability, revising the high-level judgment as experimental evidence accumulates. Analyzing a large corpus of publicly released post-training trajectories, we find that across different tasks, the agent's training strategy is locked in at the very beginning, and the entire remaining budget is spent on local adjustments within the selected strategy. We then examine three natural explanations--missing experience, missing guidance, and insufficient reasoning--with escalating interventions. Extensive experiments show that (1) an experience-driven scaffold improves execution across the board (+12.6 points on GSM8K and +40.8 on HumanEval) but leaves the strategy static; (2) human guidance effectively redirects the initial strategy, yet the agent falls back into local adjustment loops once training starts; and (3) additional inference compute pays off on easier tasks but yields almost no gain on the hardest one. In conclusion, what agents lack is neither experience, guidance, nor reasoning compute, but a mechanism for spontaneously reevaluating their strategy during execution.
title_zh: AI后训练中缺失了什么：一项关于AI的实证分析
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体如今可以端到端地对LLM进行后训练。它们能够编写代码、启动训练、评估检查点，并提升下游性能，由此带来了“AI为AI”的前景。我们认为，这一图景混淆了两种截然不同的能力：执行层面能力，即在所选训练策略内进行迭代；以及策略层面能力，即随着实验证据积累而修正高层判断。通过分析大量公开发布的后训练轨迹语料，我们发现，在不同任务中，智能体的训练策略在最初阶段就被锁定，剩余的全部预算都花在了所选策略内部的局部调整上。接着，我们考察了三种自然的解释——经验缺失、指导缺失和推理不足——并采取逐步升级的干预措施。大量实验表明：（1）经验驱动的脚手架全面改善了执行表现（在GSM8K上提升12.6个点，在HumanEval上提升40.8个点），但策略仍然保持不变；（2）人工指导能有效改变初始策略，但一旦训练开始，智能体又会退回到局部调整的循环中；（3）额外增加推理算力在较容易的任务上有所回报，但在最困难的任务上几乎毫无增益。总之，智能体所缺乏的既不是经验、指导，也不是推理算力，而是一种在执行过程中自发重新评估自身策略的机制。

title: Grading the Graders: Verification Autonomy Levels (L0-L5) for LLM Reasoning
authors: Yajie Yin
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly paired with verifiers (step checkers, self-consistency filters, tool-based fact checkers, formal proof assistants) that claim to detect the model's errors. Yet the verification literature uses the word "level" to mean at least five different things: verification granularity, concept abstraction, risk tier, system-stack layer, and the epistemic source of the ground truth. We propose Verification Autonomy Levels (VAL), a meta-standard classifying verification schemes along a single axis: where does the verification spec come from, and what does the verdict guarantee? VAL ranges from L0 (LLM self-declaration, no deterministic anchor) through L2 (objective ground truth, correctness only) to L3/L4 (decidable systems with single-property or domain-level completeness), with L5 impossible in the unrestricted case. Central to VAL is the completeness blind spot: substitution- and sampling-based verifiers can confirm that proposed candidates hold, but cannot prove that no candidate was missed. We further identify a dichotomy the literature has not stated: completeness is reachable only for formally specifiable properties, while empirical open-world verification (fact-checking, diagnosis) caps at anchored correctness (L2). We document this across four domains (symbolic mathematics, behavior monitoring, medical diagnosis, and code generation) and in the strongest existing formal-verification baseline, whose authors note the verifier "focuses on the correctness of each step." We show the levels of granularity, concept hierarchy, risk, and system stack are orthogonal to VAL, resolving a systematic conflation across 17 surveyed papers. Code and full assessment are released as supplementary material.
title_zh: 为评分者评分：LLM推理的验证自主等级（L0-L5）
abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地与验证器（步骤检查器、自一致性过滤器、基于工具的事实核查器、形式化证明助手）配对使用，这些验证器声称能够检测模型的错误。然而，验证文献中使用的“级别”一词至少指代五种不同的事物：验证粒度、概念抽象、风险层级、系统栈层以及真值的认识论来源。我们提出了验证自主级别（VAL），这是一个元标准，沿单一轴对验证方案进行分类：验证规范来自何处，以及判定保证了什么？VAL的范围从L0（LLM自我声明，无确定性锚点）经过L2（客观真值，仅保证正确性）到L3/L4（具有单属性或领域级完备性的可判定系统），其中L5在无限制情况下是不可能的。VAL的核心是完备性盲区：基于替换和采样的验证器可以确认所提出的候选成立，但无法证明没有遗漏任何候选。我们进一步识别出文献尚未陈述的二分法：完备性仅对可形式化规范的属性可达，而经验性的开放世界验证（事实核查、诊断）则止步于锚定正确性（L2）。我们在四个领域（符号数学、行为监控、医学诊断和代码生成）以及现有最强的形式化验证基线中记录了这一点，该基线的作者指出验证器“关注每一步的正确性”。我们证明了粒度、概念层级、风险和系统栈的级别与VAL是正交的，从而解决了17篇调研论文中存在的系统性混淆问题。代码和完整评估已作为补充材料发布。

title: SkillForge: Self-Distilling Agents for Project-Specific Issue Resolution
authors: Silin Chen, Han Li, Xiaodong Gu, Yuling Shi, Haibing Guan
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large language model (LLM) based agents have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in automated software issue resolution, yet they often struggle to resolve issues in a specific repository because they lack project-specific knowledge. Existing self-evolving approaches acquire such knowledge from repository history or online repair trajectories, but they either depend on available historical issue-resolution signals or incur substantial per-issue test-time exploration cost. In this paper, we propose SkillForge, a self-distillation framework that proactively acquires project-specific knowledge from the repository itself. Instead of waiting for real issues to expose project-specific knowledge gaps, SkillForge synthesizes project-specific issues by re-implementing test-covered core functionalities of the repository. By resolving these synthetic issues, SkillForge distills reusable project-specific knowledge into entity-grounded skills and associates them with relevant repository entities for future issue resolution. Extensive experiments using both open-source and closed-source models show that SkillForge consistently improves issue resolution performance over strong baselines. These results demonstrate that proactively acquiring project-specific knowledge before solving real issues substantially improves downstream software issue resolution.
title_zh: SkillForge：面向项目特定问题解决的自蒸馏智能体
abstract_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体在自动化软件问题修复方面展现出了显著的能力，但它们往往因缺乏项目特定知识而难以解决特定代码仓库中的问题。现有的自我演进方法从仓库历史或在线修复轨迹中获取此类知识，但它们要么依赖于可用的历史问题修复信号，要么会产生高昂的逐问题测试时探索成本。在本文中，我们提出了SkillForge，一种自我蒸馏框架，能够主动从代码仓库本身获取项目特定知识。SkillForge不是等待真实问题暴露出项目特定知识的缺口，而是通过重新实现仓库中测试覆盖的核心功能来合成项目特定问题。通过解决这些合成问题，SkillForge将可复用的项目特定知识蒸馏为实体锚定的技能，并将这些技能与相关的仓库实体关联起来，以用于未来的问题修复。使用开源和闭源模型进行的大量实验表明，SkillForge在问题修复性能上持续优于强基线方法。这些结果证明，在解决真实问题之前主动获取项目特定知识能够显著提升下游软件问题修复的效果。

title: Beyond LLM-Based Reasoning: Lightweight GNNs for Agent Failure Attribution
authors: Ting-Wei Li, Yuanchen Bei, Xiao Lin, Hanghang Tong
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) often exhibit complex failure modes, which frequently cause agents to produce incorrect outcomes. This motivates the task of Agent Failure Attribution: given a failed multi-agent trajectory, identify the faulty agents and their corresponding error types. Existing approaches predominantly rely on LLMs to perform failure attribution, either through direct prompting, fine-tuning on synthetic data or complex agentic pipelines. While effective, these methods incur substantial computational overhead due to long-context processing, expensive post-training and handcrafted workflows. Moreover, empirical evidence shows that even state-of-the-art models achieve limited accuracy on existing benchmarks, suggesting that scaling model size alone is insufficient. In this work, we revisit this task and question the necessity of such expensive generative solutions. We introduce AFANet, a lightweight graph-based framework that models interaction trajectories through step-level semantic signals and agent-level relationships. We show that with significantly fewer parameters and near-zero inference cost, AFANet (i) matches or outperforms LLM-based baselines, including fine-tuned models on in-domain benchmarks, (ii) maintains robust performance across different GNN architectures and (iii) can be further improved with inexpensive test-time adaptation on the OOD benchmark. Our results suggest that effective agent failure attribution does not require heavy LLM reasoning and a lightweight, structured approach can achieve strong performance.
title_zh: 超越基于大语言模型的推理：面向智能体故障归因的轻量级图神经网络
abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）常常表现出复杂的失败模式，这经常导致智能体产生错误的结果。这推动了智能体失败归因任务：给定一条失败的多智能体轨迹，识别出故障智能体及其对应的错误类型。现有方法主要依赖LLM进行失败归因，要么通过直接提示、在合成数据上微调，要么通过复杂的智能体流水线。虽然有效，但这些方法由于长上下文处理、昂贵的后训练和手工设计的工作流而产生了大量的计算开销。此外，经验证据表明，即使是最先进的模型在现有基准上也仅取得有限的准确性，这表明仅扩大模型规模是不够的。在这项工作中，我们重新审视了这一任务，并质疑这种昂贵的生成式解决方案的必要性。我们引入了AFANet，一个轻量级基于图的框架，通过步骤级语义信号和智能体级关系对交互轨迹进行建模。我们表明，凭借显著更少的参数和近乎零的推理成本，AFANet（i）在域内基准上匹配甚至超越基于LLM的基线（包括微调模型），（ii）在不同GNN架构下保持稳健性能，并且（iii）可以在OOD基准上通过廉价的测试时自适应进一步改进。我们的结果表明，有效的智能体失败归因并不需要繁重的LLM推理，一种轻量级、结构化的方法也能实现强大的性能。

title: SemaPLC: A Project-Grounded, Verification-Gated Agent Harness for PLC Code Generation
authors: Yanlun Tu, Huacan Wang, Ziyue Zhou, Jie Zhou, Ningyan Zhu, Ge Chen, Wangyi Chen, Tengfei Zhou, Yifan Zhou, Dasheng Yang, Xiaofeng Mou, Hui Zhang, Yi Xu
publish: arXiv
abstract: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) run industrial plants, and large language models can already generate independent program organization units (POUs) for them. Whether such logic integrates into an existing PLC project and then runs correctly has been checked only in limited tests. We present \textsc{SemaPLC}, a project-grounded and verification-gated agent harness assembled from conventional tools but governed by a strict completion rule. Rather than stopping when the model judges its own output adequate, \textsc{SemaPLC} declares a task complete only when logged external checks confirm it. Those checks cover the specification, the compilation, and the behavior on a live runtime. On 117 independent-POU tasks matching existing benchmarks, it attains the highest strict verified pass rate on all seven models (72.6\% mean). On a project-context track of 65 tasks whose generated logic must compile and run inside a real project, it attains the highest mean on integrated compilation, static behavior, and dynamic behavior. Of the three layers, dynamic behavior is the most revealing. We measure it by deploying the generated and the reference logic to a live PLC runtime and comparing their executed traces. All methods fall within 10 static points of one another, whereas dynamic scores separate them sharply, from 22.4 to 31.4 for the baselines against 52.2 for \textsc{SemaPLC}. Overall, our verification-gated harness raises the mean at every layer and most sharply at runtime. Execution, not static scoring, is the faithful test of whether generated control logic actually works. \textsc{SemaPLC} is open-sourced at https://github.com/midea-ai/SemaPLC.
title_zh: SemaPLC：项目锚定、验证门控的 PLC 代码生成智能体框架
abstract_zh: 可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）驱动着工业工厂的运行，而大语言模型已经能够为其生成独立的程序组织单元（POU）。然而，此类逻辑能否集成到现有PLC项目中并正确运行，此前仅在有限的测试中得到验证。我们提出\textsc{SemaPLC}，这是一个基于项目落地且经过验证门控的智能体框架，由传统工具组装而成，但受严格的完成规则约束。\textsc{SemaPLC}不会在模型自认为输出足够时停止任务，而是只有在记录在案的外部检查确认结果无误后才宣告任务完成。这些检查涵盖规范符合性、编译正确性以及实时运行时的行为表现。在117个与现有基准相匹配的独立POU任务上，它在全部七个模型上均取得了最高的严格验证通过率（均值72.6\%）。在包含65个任务的项目上下文轨道中，所生成的逻辑必须在真实项目内完成编译并运行，它在集成编译、静态行为和动态行为三个层面均取得了最高均值。在这三个层面中，动态行为最具揭示性。我们通过将生成逻辑与参考逻辑部署到实时PLC运行环境并比较二者的执行轨迹来对其进行度量。所有方法在静态得分上彼此相差不超过10分，而动态得分则将它们显著区分开来：基线方法的得分区间为22.4至31.4，而\textsc{SemaPLC}则达到52.2。总体而言，我们的验证门控框架在每个层面都提升了均值，且在运行时层面提升最为显著。执行，而非静态评分，才是检验所生成控制逻辑是否真正有效的可靠标准。\textsc{SemaPLC}已开源，代码位于https://github.com/midea-ai/SemaPLC。

title: Contract-Aware Rescue of a Drifted Isabelle Development: The Double-Tank Case Study
authors: Jim Woodcock, Gabriel Leite, Augusto Sampaio, Ran Wei
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large language models can propose proofs for interactive theorem provers, but a successful build does not show the surrounding verification task was preserved. We study this problem in an Isabelle development of a sampled-data double-tank controller. The work began with nine theories and ten unfinished obligations, grew to a 16-theory build without sorry, oops, added axiomatisation, or oracle use, and accumulated 23 stable and 36 broken proof states. A retrospective audit found material changes in 16 of the 100 original declarations, including a weakened end-to-end assurance theorem that assumed three of the four requirements in its conclusion. We used CAPRI, a contract-aware proof-repair tool, to govern a reconstruction by combining Isabelle acceptance with an independent check of repository changes against machine-readable edit contracts. The reconstruction discharged all ten scoped obligations within the original nine-theory structure. A secondary replay by a co-author reproduced the R10 build, contract checks, control tests, and principal audit findings; independent replication remains future work. Operational end-to-end verification remains incomplete: we still need to connect operational executions to the reconstructed quantitative trace contract, a task requiring an extended contract.
title_zh: 契约感知的漂移 Isabelle 开发拯救：双水箱案例研究
abstract_zh: 大语言模型可以为交互式定理证明器提出证明，但一次成功的构建并不能表明所涉及的验证任务得以保留。我们在一个采样数据双罐控制器的Isabelle开发中研究了这个问题。这项工作最初包含九个理论和十个未完成的证明义务，后来发展为一个包含16个理论的构建，全程没有使用`sorry`、`oops`、新增公理化或oracle，并积累了23个稳定和36个损坏的证明状态。一项回顾性审计发现，在100个原始声明中有16处实质性变更，其中包括一个被弱化的端到端保证定理，该定理在其结论中假设了四个需求中的三个。我们使用了CAPRI——一个契约感知的证明修复工具——通过将Isabelle的接受与依据机器可读编辑契约对仓库变更进行的独立检查相结合，来管理重构过程。重构在原始的九理论结构内完成了所有十个范围内的证明义务。一位合著者进行的二次重放复现了R10构建、契约检查、控制测试和主要审计结果；独立复制仍是未来的工作。操作性的端到端验证仍不完整：我们仍需将操作执行与重构后的定量轨迹契约连接起来，这是一项需要扩展契约的任务。

title: MLREF: Efficient Module Reuse for Reward Design in Reinforcement Learning via Large Language Models
authors: Chenglin Liu, Xun Wang, Ruishuo Chen, Zhuoran Li, Longbo Huang
publish: arXiv
abstract: Reward function design remains a bottleneck in reinforcement learning. While large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated reward generation, existing methods generate and revise reward functions as monolithic programs, making it difficult to reliably preserve and reuse effective components discovered in earlier iterations, leading to unstable performance across iterations. To address this, we propose Module Level Reward Evolution Framework (MLREF). At the core of MLREF is a module pool, a persistent repository of reusable reward components. MLREF treats the module pool as the primary optimization object: the pool evolves across iterations by accumulating successful modules, refining underperforming ones, and reusing proven components; while reward functions are constructed as linear combinations of modules drawn from this pool. To drive this evolution, MLREF integrates three mechanisms: reflection-based refinement, hybrid credit assignment, and a merge strategy with rollback, which together improve the effectiveness and robustness of reward optimization. Experiments on 17 tasks show that MLREF outperforms strong baselines by 25.2% in locomotion and 6.6% in manipulation, with more stable optimization dynamics.
title_zh: MLREF：基于大语言模型的强化学习奖励设计中的高效模块复用
abstract_zh: 奖励函数设计仍然是强化学习中的一个瓶颈。虽然大语言模型（LLMs）已经实现了奖励的自动化生成，但现有方法将奖励函数作为整体式程序进行生成和修改，难以可靠地保留和重用早期迭代中发现的有效组件，从而导致跨迭代的性能不稳定。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了模块级奖励进化框架（MLREF）。MLREF的核心是一个模块池，即一个持久化的可复用奖励组件库。MLREF将模块池作为主要优化对象：池子通过积累成功的模块、改进表现不佳的模块以及重用经过验证的组件来跨迭代进化；同时，奖励函数由从该池中抽取的模块线性组合而成。为了驱动这一进化，MLREF集成了三种机制：基于反思的精化、混合信用分配以及带回滚的合并策略，它们共同提高了奖励优化的有效性和鲁棒性。在17个任务上的实验表明，MLREF在运动控制任务上比强基线高出25.2%，在操作任务上高出6.6%，并且具有更稳定的优化动态。

title: LEDGER: Claim-to-Evidence Trace Graphs for Auditing LLM Agents
authors: Daehong Kim, Haichao Miao, Shusen Liu
publish: arXiv
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can now carry out long-horizon technical workflows involving complex tool use, code execution, file edits, and generated artifacts. As agents do more work faster, the productivity bottleneck shifts from producing outputs to auditing whether those outputs are correct and trustworthy. Agent observability systems make fine-grained execution events visible, but visibility alone still leaves reviewers to reconstruct which actions, artifacts, and validation steps matter for a particular conclusion. We introduce LEDGER - Layered Evidence and Decision Graphs for Execution Review, a tracing and review system that builds layered trace graphs over observed agent sessions. LEDGER preserves Trace Records while grouping them into Evidence Nodes and Workflow Nodes, representing artifacts as evidence anchors, and adding typed semantic edges that connect claims to supporting actions, artifacts, and checks. Through data-analysis and coding examples, we show how the resulting traces expose workflow decisions, artifact lineage, repair steps, validation coverage, and claim-support paths for evidence-centered audit.
title_zh: LEDGER：用于审计LLM智能体的声明到证据追踪图
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体现在能够执行涉及复杂工具使用、代码执行、文件编辑和生成产物的长周期技术工作流。随着智能体以更快的速度完成更多工作，生产力瓶颈从产出内容转移到审计这些产出是否正确且值得信赖。智能体可观测性系统使细粒度的执行事件变得可见，但仅靠可见性仍不足以让审查者重建哪些操作、产物和验证步骤对特定结论至关重要。我们引入LEDGER——面向执行审查的分层证据与决策图（Layered Evidence and Decision Graphs for Execution Review），这是一个追踪与审查系统，它在观测到的智能体会话之上构建分层轨迹图。LEDGER在保留轨迹记录（Trace Records）的同时，将它们分组为证据节点（Evidence Nodes）和工作流节点（Workflow Nodes），将产物表示为证据锚点，并添加连接声明与其支持性操作、产物和检查的类型化语义边。通过数据分析和编码示例，我们展示了由此产生的轨迹如何为以证据为中心的审计暴露工作流决策、产物血缘、修复步骤、验证覆盖率和声明-支持路径。
